text: The predicted fact for the chief complaint is a headache disorder of uncertain type, as assessed by the doctor. This is based on the patient's reported symptoms of severe headaches for a while, along with other associated symptoms such as neck tightness, occasional nausea, and blurry vision. The doctor has also noted that the patient has a history of high blood pressure, thin bones, and heart failure, which may be contributing factors to the headache disorder. The doctor has also planned to arrange an MRI of the brain and an eye pressure check to further investigate the cause of the headaches. The patient has been advised to keep a headache diary and to bring their latest prescription or medication box to the next visit. A follow-up consultation is also planned after the scan. The doctor has also noted some uncertainties regarding the patient's medication and the duration of the headaches.
